IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p301#2/r2.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p301#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p301#2/r2.claim: In the two descriptions of the spring, bāʾ can mean from, or the verb can take the spring directly as its object.
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p301#2/r2.anchor: ويكون بمعنى يشربها عباد الله ويشرب منها.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p224/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p224/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p224/r3.claim: Verses 18–28 describe the fate of the loyal, faithful, and God-fearing.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p224/r3.anchor: A mention of the fate of those loyal to God who professed faith in the Hereafter

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r1.claim: The accusative aynan is specification, while biha is locative; the favored wine is properly drunk beside a river, unlike worldly wine consumed wherever available.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r1.anchor: The word !ًْﻋﻴﻨﺎ is declined in the accusative because of specification

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r2.claim: He rejects the common rendering of bi as ‘from it’ as vague and redundant, preferring its customary locative sense because Tasnim has already been named as the source.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r2.anchor: Our exegetes have not been able to determine the true connotation of the particle ب

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r3.claim: Drinking pure wine on a river bank has its own etiquette, unlike the wretched wine of this world.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p234/r3.anchor: The most appropriate place to drink wine is on a river bank

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r17.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r17.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r17.claim: He parses عينا as an accusative of praise; al-Zajjaj instead calls it circumstantial.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r17.anchor: وعينا نصب على المدح. وقال الزجاج: على الحال

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r18.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r18.speaker: الأخفش
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r18.claim: He says يشرب بها means drinking it or from it, or uses يشرب with the sense of being refreshed by it.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r18.anchor: وقال الأخفش: يسقون عينا، يشرب بها: أي يشربها أو منها، أو ضمن يشرب معنى يروى بها

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r19.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r19.speaker: ابن مسعود، ابن عباس، الحسن، أبو صالح
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r19.claim: They say the near ones drink Tasnim pure, while it is blended for the righteous.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r19.anchor: قال ابن مسعود وابن عباس والحسن وأبو صالح: يشربها المقربون صرفا ويمزج للأبرار

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r20.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r20.speaker: الجمهور
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r20.claim: Most commentators distinguish the righteous as the companions of the right and the near ones as the foremost; others treat the two terms as synonyms for all who enjoy Paradise.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p430#2/r20.anchor: ومذهب الجمهور: الأبرار هم أصحاب اليمين، وأن المقربين هم السابقون

STUDYQURAN:83:27/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r1.speaker: Most commentators
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r1.claim: Most commentators agree that Tasnīm is Heaven's purest and noblest drink.
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r1.anchor: Most commentators agree that Tasnīm is the purest and noblest drink of Heaven

STUDYQURAN:83:27/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r6.speaker: Some
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r6.claim: Some say Tasnīm is a spring mixed with the pure sealed wine for the companions of the right, while those brought near drink its purest form.
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r6.anchor: Some say that Tasnīm is a spring whose waters are mixed with the pure wine sealed for the companions of the right

STUDYQURAN:83:27/r7.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r7.speaker: Others
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r7.claim: Others say those brought near drink Tasnīm unmixed, while all other inhabitants of Paradise drink it mixed.
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r7.anchor: Similarly, others say those brought nigh drink of it unmixed, while all the other inhabitants of Paradise drink of it mixed

STUDYQURAN:83:27/r8.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r8.speaker: al-Rāzī
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r8.claim: Al-Rāzī reads Tasnīm as knowledge of God and delight in gazing upon Him: the brought-near see only God, while companions of the right also attend to created paradisal delights, hence their mixed drink.
STUDYQURAN:83:27/r8.anchor: According to al-Rāzī, Tasnīm “is the knowledge of God

TAB-FULL:v24p221/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p221/r4.speaker: سائر أهل التأويل
TAB-FULL:v24p221/r4.claim: Most exegetes say Tasnim is a spring mixed into the nectar of the companions of the right, while the nearest drink it pure.
TAB-FULL:v24p221/r4.anchor: وأما سائر أهل التأويل، فقالوا: هو عين يمزج بها الرحيق لأصحاب اليمين، وأما المقربون، فيشربونها صرفا

TAB-FULL:v24p221/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p221/r5.speaker: عبد الله
TAB-FULL:v24p221/r5.claim: Abdullah reports that Tasnim is a Garden spring which the nearest drink pure and which is blended for the companions of the right.
TAB-FULL:v24p221/r5.anchor: عن عبد الله بن مرة، عن مسروق، عن عبد الله، في قوله: {من تسنيم} [المطففين: 27] قال: عين في الجنة

TAB-FULL:v24p224/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas says the nearest drink Tasnim pure and it is blended for those below them; he also calls it a Garden spring mixed into the wine.
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس، قوله: {ومزاجه من تسنيم عينا يشرب بها المقربون} [المطففين: 28] صرفا، ويمزج فيها لمن دونهم

TAB-FULL:v24p224/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r4.speaker: أبو صالح
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r4.claim: Abu Salih calls it the noblest drink in the Garden, pure for the nearest and blended for the rest.
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r4.anchor: عن أبي صالح، في قوله: {ومزاجه من تسنيم} [المطففين: 27] قال: هو أشرف شراب في الجنة، هو للمقربين صرف

TAB-FULL:v24p224/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r5.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r5.claim: Qatada describes Tasnim as a noble Garden spring, pure for the nearest and blended for all other people of the Garden.
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r5.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله {ومزاجه من تسنيم} [المطففين: 27] شراب شريف، عين في الجنة يشربها المقربون صرفا

TAB-FULL:v24p224/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r8.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r8.claim: He concludes that the nectar is mixed from a spring flowing down on them from above; the nearest drink it pure, while the rest of the Garden's people receive it mixed.
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r8.anchor: فتأويل الكلام ومزاج الرحيق من عين تسنم عليهم من فوقهم، فتنصب عليهم

TAB-FULL:v24p224/r9.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r9.speaker: نحويّو البصرة
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r9.claim: Basran grammarians say عينا may be accusative after an implied يسقون, or as praise detached from the preceding syntax, meaning 'I mean a spring.'
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r9.anchor: قال بعض نحويي البصرة: إن شئت جعلت نصبه على يسقون عينا. وإن شئت جعلته مدحا

TAB-FULL:v24p224/r10.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r10.speaker: نحويّو الكوفة
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r10.claim: Kufan grammarians give an analysis beginning with an implied indefinite عين after من تسنيم, then accusative after tanwin; they illustrate it with 90:15 and 77:25.
TAB-FULL:v24p224/r10.anchor: وقال بعض نحويي الكوفة: نصب العين على وجهين: أحدهما: أن ينوى من تسنيم عين، فإذا نونت نصبت

TABATABAI:83:28-36/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:83:28-36/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:83:28-36/r1.claim: Aynan is accusative as praise or specification; the phrase describing who drinks from it explains Tasnim.

TABATABAI:83:28-36/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:83:28-36/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:83:28-36/r2.claim: The close ones drink Tasnim pure, whereas the sealed nectar of the righteous is mixed with it; this shows Tasnim's superiority and the close ones' higher rank.
TABATABAI:83:28-36/r2.anchor: الرحيق المختوم، ويدل ذلك أولا على أن التسنيم أفضل من الرحيق المختوم

TABRISI:83:27-30/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:83:27-30/r7.speaker: مسروق
TABRISI:83:27-30/r7.claim: Masruq says those brought near drink Tasnim unmixed, while it is mixed into the cups of the people of the right to make them pleasant.
TABRISI:83:27-30/r7.anchor: قال مسروق يشربها المقربون صرفا ويمزج بها كأس أصحاب اليمين

TABRISI:83:27-30/r12.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:83:27-30/r12.speaker: ابن مسعود وابن عباس
TABRISI:83:27-30/r12.claim: Ibn Masʿud and Ibn Abbas say the spring is pure for those brought near, while the rest of Paradise’s people drink it mixed.
TABRISI:83:27-30/r12.anchor: أي هي خالصة للمقربين يشربونها صرفا ويمزج لسائر أهل الجنة عن ابن مسعود وابن عباس

BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r9.claim: ʿAynan is accusative as an expression of praise or specification, with an implied I mean.
BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r9.anchor: {عينا} نصب على المدح والاختصاص أي بتقدير أعني

BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r10.claim: Those brought near to God drink Tasnīm pure, while it is mixed for the other people of Paradise, the companions of the right; the preposition may be extra or mean from.
BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r10.anchor: {يشرب بها المقربون} من جناب الله قربا معنويا روحانيا أي يشربون ماءها

BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r11.claim: In the spiritual Paradise, Tasnīm signifies knowledge and love of God and the joy of seeing His face; pure drink symbolizes unalloyed divine love, while mixed drink reflects mixed love.
BURSEVI:v10p288#2/r11.anchor: وفيه إشارة إلى أن التسنيم في الجنة الروحانية هو معرفة الله ومحبته

THALABI:v10p156/r17.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p156/r17.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p156/r17.claim: “Yashrabu biha” means “drink from it”; another wording says the near ones drink it.
THALABI:v10p156/r17.anchor: عينا يشرب بها أي منها، وقيل يشربها المقربون

THALABI:v10p156/r18.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p156/r18.speaker: الحريري والواسطي
THALABI:v10p156/r18.claim: Al-Hariri and al-Wasiti read the near ones’ pure drink as a mystical image of closeness, intimacy, contentment, and witnessing God.
THALABI:v10p156/r18.anchor: قال الحريري والواسطي: يشرب بها المقربون صرفا على بساط القرب في مجلس الأنس ورياض القدس

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r1.claim: If tasnīm names the water, ʿaynan can be parsed as an implied accusative meaning “I mean a spring,” or as a circumstantial accusative separated from the definite noun tasnīm.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r1.anchor: إن جعلنا "التسنيم" اسما للماء، ف"عينا" تنتصب على وجهين، أحدهما: أعني عينا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r2.claim: If tasnīm derives from sanām, ʿaynan can be a causal accusative, as in the verse about feeding an orphan on a day of hunger.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r2.anchor: وإن جعلنا التسنيم مشتقا من السنام انتصب "عينا" على أنه مفعول له

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r3.speaker: الفراء والزجاج والأخفش
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r3.claim: Al-Farrāʾ, al-Zajjāj, and al-Akhfash also allow ʿaynan to be governed by يسقون عينا, meaning “from a spring.”
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r3.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون منصوبا بقوله "يسقون عينا"، أي من عين. وهذا قول الفراء (¬6) والزجاج (¬7)، (والأخفش)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r4.speaker: عبد الله ومالك بن الحارث ومقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r4.claim: ʿAbd Allāh says the close ones drink it pure while it is mixed for the people of the right; Mālik b. al-Ḥārith and Muqātil give the same view.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p344/r4.anchor: قال عبد الله: يشرب بها المقربون) (¬4) صرفا، ويمزج لأصحاب اليمين

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:83:23-29/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:83:23-29/r7.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:83:23-29/r7.claim: Those brought near drink from that spring directly.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:83:23-29/r7.anchor: { عينا يشرب بها المقربون } أي: يشربها المقربون.

QASHANI:83:27-28/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:83:27-28/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:83:27-28/r3.claim: Tasnim is a spring drunk unmixed by the perfected, arrived people who realize unity of essence, stand by God, and remain steadfast in the detailed station.
QASHANI:83:27-28/r3.anchor: عين يشرب بها المقربون صرفة وهم الكاملون الواصلون إلى توحيد الذات من أهل التمكين القائمين بالله في مقام التفصيل بالاستقامة

QASHANI:83:27-28/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:83:27-28/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:83:27-28/r4.claim: Different names and drinks distinguish the steadfast in detail from those absorbed in unity: “near ones” marks distinction with nearness, while “servants of God” and kafur signal subjugation, annihilation, and sheer undifferentiated unity.
QASHANI:83:27-28/r4.anchor: ففرق بين أهل الاستقامة في مقام التفصيل وأهل الاستغراق في مقام الجمع باختلاف اسمهم واسم شرابهم مع إيجاد حقيقتهم وحقيقة شرابهم

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r1.claim: Tesnīm derives from elevation or raising like a hump, and by extension names a high fountain of Paradise.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r1.anchor: hörgüçleyerek yukarı yükseltmek, terfî‘etmek mânasına masdar olup yükseklik mânasıyla cennet çeşmelerinden

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r2.speaker: İbn Abbas
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas calls Tasnīm the highest of Paradise's drinks.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r2.anchor: İbn Abbas Hazretleri demiştir ki: “Ehl-i cennetin içkilerinin eşref ve a‘lâsı tesnîm’dir.

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r3.claim: Elmalılı reports al-Kalbī's view that Tasnīm comes to the people of Paradise from above them.

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r4.speaker: adı verilmeyen görüş
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r4.claim: Another account describes Tasnīm flowing aloft in the air and pouring enough into each vessel; the elevated drinkers drink it and are elevated by it.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r4.anchor: havada müsennem olarak cereyan edip kablarına kifayeti kadar munsab olur. Ve onu yüksek olanlar içer, içenleri yükseltir

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r5.claim: The nearest drink the Tasnīm fountain itself, unmixed, as their own drink.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r5.anchor: içerler yani aynıyla içerler, sade o tesnîmi içer

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r7.speaker: İbn Abbas
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas explains Tasnīm's rank by saying the nearest drink it pure while the people of the right receive it blended.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r7.anchor: Çünkü mukarrebûn onu sırf olarak içerler, ashâb-ı yemîne ise mezcolunur

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r8.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r8.speaker: author
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r8.claim: The author identifies the righteous as the people of the right and the nearest as the foremost, following the hierarchy in al-Wāqiʿa.

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r9.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r9.speaker: author
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r9.claim: The earlier phrase about the nearest witnessing the record, alongside the saying contrasting the righteous and the nearest, supports their distinct ranks.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r9.anchor: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ’dan ve حَسَنَاتُ الأَْبـْرَارِ سَيِّئَاتُ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ ma‘rûfesinden

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r10.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r10.speaker: author
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r10.claim: The ascending sequence suggests Tasnīm is superior to sealed nectar, as the nearest rank above the righteous is superior to theirs.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r10.anchor: âyetin terakki ifade eden siyâkından da tesnîmin o rahîk-ı mahtûmdan efdal ve a‘lâ olduğu anlaşılır

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r11.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r11.speaker: author
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r11.claim: One proposed rendering says the nearest drink the very fountain of Tasnīm as their own wine.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r11.anchor: Ayn-ı tesnîmi mukarrebûn içer, o onların şarabıdır

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r12.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r12.speaker: author
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r12.claim: Another proposed sense is that the nearest are sated and take delight through Tasnīm.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r12.anchor: mukarrebûn tesnîm ile kanar, onunla mütelezziz olurlar

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r13.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r13.speaker: author
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r13.claim: A further reading gives bā the sense of min: the nearest drink from Tasnīm, blending it with the sealed nectar.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r13.anchor: “mukarrebîn ondan içer. Mukarrebîn onunla mezcederek o rahîki içerler”

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r14.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r14.speaker: author
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r14.claim: Elmalılı calls the blended-drink reading more apparent, but says it fails to distinguish the nearest from the righteous or explain Tasnīm's special association with the nearest.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r14.anchor: daha zâhir gibi görünürse de bunda mukarrebîn ile ebrârın mertebeleri fark edilmemiş

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r15.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r15.speaker: başka bir görüş
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r15.claim: Another view says even blended Tasnīm is exclusive to the nearest, leaving the lower-ranking righteous unable to drink it and the nearest unable to drink it pure.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r15.anchor: Yahut da onun memzûcen içilmesi bile mukarrebîne mahsus olduğu

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r16.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r16.speaker: İbn Abbas, İbn Mes‘ûd, Hasan, Ebû Sâlih
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r16.claim: Elmalılı prefers the transmitted view that the nearest drink Tasnīm pure and it is blended for the righteous, also followed by the majority's rank distinction.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r16.anchor: İbn Abbas gibi İbn Mes‘ûd’dan, Hasan’dan, Ebû Sâlih’ten dahi “mukarrebûn onu sırfen içer ve ebrâra mezcolunur”

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r17.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r17.speaker: bazıları
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r17.claim: Some equate the righteous and the nearest as labels for all who enjoy Paradise; Elmalılı rejects this as missing the verse's distinction and force.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r17.anchor: bazıları “bu âyette ebrâr ile mukarrebûn bir mânayadır, cennette mütena‘‘im olanlara ıtlak edilmiştir” demişler ise de

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r18.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r18.speaker: Râzî
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r18.claim: Rāzī infers graded rivers and ranks; spiritually, Tasnīm is knowledge and vision of God, while sealed nectar is delight in contemplating creation, so the nearest attend only to God.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r18.anchor: Râzî burada İbn Abbas’ın kavlini nakilden sonra şöyle demiştir: “Ben de derim ki, bu şuna delâlet eyler: Nehirler fazilette mütefâvittir.

ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r19.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r19.speaker: author
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r19.claim: After explaining the fate of the fraudulent and the righteous in the afterlife according to their deeds, the passage turns to their conditions in this life and the next.
ELMALILI:83:12-28#3/r19.anchor: Tatfiften nehiy ve ba‘s ü cezâ gününe imana davet siyâkında ehl-i cürm olan füccâr

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:83:22/r10.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:83:22/r10.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:83:22/r10.claim: Paradise is a home of peace, happiness, and virtue; its blessings will not bring envy, conflict, unhappiness, injustice, illness, grief, or similar harms.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:83:22/r10.anchor: oradaki nimetlerin –dünya dilindeki kelimelerle ifade edilse de– insanlar arasında kıskançlık, huzursuzluk, çekişme, mutsuzluk, haksızlık, hastalık, keder vb. olumsuzluklar doğuracak türden olmayacağını açıkça göstermektedir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:83:22/r14.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:83:22/r14.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:83:22/r14.claim: Exegetical works say verse 28, describing a spring from which those brought near to God drink, explains Tasnim.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:83:22/r14.anchor: Tefsirlerde, “Allah’a yakın olanların içecekleri bir kaynak” meâlindeki 28. âyetin “tesnîm”i açıkladığı belirtilmektedir

SULAMI:v2p382#5/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r1.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r1.claim: Some say the close ones drink it pure, while it is mixed for the companions of the right.
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r1.anchor: قال بعضهم : قال يشرب بها المقربون صرفا ، ويمزج لأصحاب اليمين

SULAMI:v2p382#5/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r2.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r2.claim: Some say that bearing the attributes alone does not qualify everyone to witness the Essence; the close ones bear both the Essence and all the attributes.
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r2.anchor: قال بعضهم : قال يشرب بها المقربون صرفا ، ويمزج لأصحاب اليمين فليس كل من احتمل حمل الصفات قوى على مشاهدة الذات

SULAMI:v2p382#5/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r3.speaker: الواسطي
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r3.claim: Al-Wāsiṭī says the close ones drink it pure while witnessing their beloved.
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r3.anchor: وقال الواسطي رحمه الله : يشرب بها المقربون صرفا على مشاهدة محبوبهم

SULAMI:v2p382#5/r4.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r4.speaker: الجريري
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r4.claim: Al-Jurayrī describes the close ones drinking on the carpet of nearness, in intimacy and the gardens of holiness, from a cup of contentment while beholding God.
SULAMI:v2p382#5/r4.anchor: قال الجريري : يشرب بها المقربون على بساط القرب في مجلس الأنس ، ورياض القدس بكأس الرضا على مشاهدة الحق عز وجل

DAMGHANI:v1p335/r19.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p335/r19.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p335/r19.claim: ʿAyn can mean a drink or spring of Paradise, including the spring from which those brought near drink.
DAMGHANI:v1p335/r19.anchor: الثاني العين شراب اهل الجنة قوله تعالى في سورة الانسان عينا يشرب بها عباد الله يفجرونها تفجيرا وكذلك قوله تعالى

FARRA:v3p248/r4.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p248/r4.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p248/r4.claim: One parse takes عينا as an indefinite spring apposed to تسنيم; when عين is indefinite it is accusative, as in the cited Quranic examples.
FARRA:v3p248/r4.anchor: من تسنيم عين، فإذا نونت نصبت

FARRA:v3p248/r5.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p248/r5.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p248/r5.claim: Another parse takes عينًا from water that wells up; it remains accusative whether تسنيم is a proper water name or not, although عين is respectively definite or indefinite with it.

NAHHAS:v5p182/r2.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p182/r2.speaker: الأخفش
NAHHAS:v5p182/r2.claim: Al-Akhfash makes عين accusative as the object of يسقون.
NAHHAS:v5p182/r2.anchor: في نصب عين خمسة أقوال قول الأخفش إنها منصوبة بيسقون

NAHHAS:v5p182/r3.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p182/r3.speaker: محمد بن يزيد
NAHHAS:v5p182/r3.claim: Muhammad ibn Yazid says, as conveyed by Ali ibn Sulayman, that عين can only be accusative by supplying أعني.
NAHHAS:v5p182/r3.anchor: وقال محمد بن يزيد حكاه لنا علي بن سليمان لا يصح لي أن تكون منصوبة إلا بمعنى أعني

NAHHAS:v5p182/r4.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p182/r4.speaker: الفراء
NAHHAS:v5p182/r4.claim: Al-Farra parses it as عينًا من تسنيم, with tanwin producing the accusative, as in the cited Qur’anic construction.
NAHHAS:v5p182/r4.anchor: وقال الفراء أي من تسنيم عين ثم نونت فتنصب

NAHHAS:v5p182/r5.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p182/r5.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p182/r5.claim: A fourth parsing is to construe the phrase as تسنيم عينًا.

NAHHAS:v5p182/r6.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p182/r6.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p182/r6.claim: Al-Nahhas prefers treating تسنيم as a definite name for the water and عين as an indefinite noun made accusative on that basis.
NAHHAS:v5p182/r6.anchor: والقول الخامس أن يكون تسنيم اسما للماء معرفة وعين نكرة فنصب لذلك قال أبو جعفر وهذا القول أولى بالصواب

NAHHAS:v5p182/r7.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p182/r7.speaker: الضحاك
NAHHAS:v5p182/r7.claim: Al-Dahhak says Tasnim is a spring flowing down from the highest part of Paradise, and no spring there is more honored.
NAHHAS:v5p182/r7.anchor: عن الضحاك قال تسنيم عين تتسنم من أعلى الجنة ليس في الجنة عين أشرف منها

NAHHAS:v5p182/r8.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p182/r8.speaker: مجاهد
NAHHAS:v5p182/r8.claim: Mujahid glosses Tasnim as elevation; the word can describe water run down from a high place, a raised grave, or a camel’s hump.
NAHHAS:v5p182/r8.anchor: قال تسنيم علو وكذا الاشتقاق يقال تسنمت الماء أتسنمه تسنيما إذا أجريته من موضع عال

NAHHAS:v5p182/r9.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p182/r9.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p182/r9.claim: Although Tasnim is a definite feminine name, it takes tanwin because it is construed as a masculine name for water; عينًا جاريًا is circumstantial.
NAHHAS:v5p182/r9.anchor: فلم انصرف تسنيم وهو معرفة اسم للمؤنث قيل تقديره أنه اسم لمذكر للماء الجاري من ذلك الموضع العالي ومعنى عينا جاريا فقد صارت في موضع الحال

SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r1.speaker: الزجاج
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r1.claim: Al-Zajjaj parses عينا as a circumstantial accusative from تسنيم, though the author notes that this is problematic because تسنيم is a proper name for a particular thing and is a concrete noun.
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r1.anchor: أنه حال، قاله الزجاج، يعني من " تسنيم " لأنه علم لشيء بعينه، إلا أنه يشكل بكونه جامدا

SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r2.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r2.claim: Al-Zamakhshari parses عينا as an accusative of praise.
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r2.anchor: أنه منصوب على المدح، قاله الزمخشري

SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r3.speaker: الأخفش
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r3.claim: Al-Akhfash makes عينا the object of an implied يسقون.
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r3.anchor: أنها منصوبة ب يسقون مقدرا، قاله الأخفش

SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r5.claim: Alternatively, the ب in بها is extra.

SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:83:28/r6.claim: Alternatively, يشرب is construed to include the sense of يروي, to give drink or quench.

ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r3.claim: The spring comes to the people of Paradise from above, wafting toward them from the chambers.
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r3.anchor: تأتيهم من علو عينا تنسم عليهم من الغرف

ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r4.claim: One analysis makes ʿaynan an accusative object, as in the wording of 90:14.
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r4.anchor: فعينا في هذا القول منصوبة مفعولة، كما قال: (أو إطعام في يوم ذي مسغبة (14) يتيما)

ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r5.claim: Alternatively, ʿaynan is the object of yasqūn, meaning they drink from a spring.
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r5.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون (عينا) منصوبة بقوله يسقون عينا، أي من عين

ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r6.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r6.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r6.claim: A third analysis makes ʿaynan an accusative circumstantial, with tasnīm definite and ʿaynan indefinite.
ZAJJAJ:v5p300/r6.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون عينا منصوبا على الحال، ويكون (تسنيم) معرفة و (عينا) نكرة

ASAD-NOTES:83:25#n10/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:83:25#n10/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:83:25#n10/r1.claim: Asad connects the spring drunk by those near to God with the drinks described in 76:5–6.

SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#8/r13.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#8/r13.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#8/r13.claim: The same hierarchy appears in al-Muṭaffifīn: the abrār receive wine mixed with Tasnīm, while the higher muqarrabūn drink pure from its spring, reward matching their devotion.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#8/r13.anchor: أي: إن المقربين يشربون من عين التسنيم خالصة، فإنهم كما أخلصوا أنفسهم وأعمالهم لله أخلص لهم الشراب

ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r1.claim: ʿAynan is accusative as an expression of praise; al-Zajjāj instead takes it as a circumstantial accusative from tasnīm, allowed because it is specified by ‘the near ones drink from it’ or interpreted adjectivally.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r1.anchor: عينا نصب على المدح وقالالزجاج على الحال من تسليم قيل وصح كونه حالا مع جموده

ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r2.claim: The bāʾ may be extra (‘drink it’), mean ‘from,’ indicate drinking to satisfaction, express enjoyment, indicate mixing, or imply sufficiency; Alusi questions the mixing analysis.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r2.anchor: والباء إما زائدة أي يشربها أو بمعنى من أي يشرب منها أو على تضمين يشرب معنى يروي

ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r3.claim: Ibn Masʿūd, Ibn ʿAbbās, al-Ḥasan, and Abū Ṣāliḥ say the near ones drink Tasnīm pure, while the righteous drink it mixed.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r3.anchor: فقد قال ابن مسعود وابن عباس والحسن وأبو صالح يشرب بها المقربون صرفا وتمزج للأبرار

ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r4.speaker: الجمهور
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r4.claim: The majority identify the righteous as the people of the right and the near ones as the foremost; the latter drink pure Tasnīm because they are absorbed in love of God rather than sealed nectar.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r4.anchor: ومذهب الجمهور أن الأبرار هم أصحاب اليمين وأن المقربين هم السابقون كأنهم إنما كان شرابهم صرف التسليم لاشتغالهم عن الرحيق المختوم

ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r5.speaker: قوم
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r5.claim: Some say the righteous and the near ones are synonymous here, encompassing all who are blessed in Paradise.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p76#2/r5.anchor: وقال قوم الأبرار والمقربون في هذه السورة بمعنى واحد يشتمل كل من نعم في الجنة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#2/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#2/r5.speaker: ابن مسعود وابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#2/r5.claim: Ibn Masʿūd and Ibn ʿAbbās say the brought-near drink Tasnim undiluted, while it is mixed into the drink of the other people of Paradise.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#2/r5.anchor: قال ابن مسعود وابن عباس: هو خالص

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#3/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#3/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#3/r1.claim: ʿAynan is parsed as a circumstantial accusative (ḥāl).

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#3/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#3/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#3/r2.claim: The phrase yashrabu bihā means that the brought-near drink from the spring.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#3/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#3/r3.speaker: قيل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p368#3/r3.claim: An alternative gloss says the brought-near drink it undiluted.

BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r1.claim: The closest servants drink Tasnim unmixed because they have occupied themselves only with God.
BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r1.anchor: فإنهم يشربونها صرفا لأنهم لم يشتغلوا بغير الله

BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r2.claim: Tasnim is mixed for the other inhabitants of Paradise.

BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r3.claim: The accusative may be for praise or a circumstantial accusative from Tasnim.
BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r3.anchor: وانتصاب { عينا } على المدح أو الحال { من تسنيم }

BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r4.claim: The discussion of the preposition here is the same as for the phrase about God's servants drinking by it.
BAYDAWI-FULL:83:28-33/r4.anchor: والكلام في الباء كما في يشرب بها عباد الله

BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r12.claim: The preposition bi in يشرب بها indicates drinking by means of or on account of the spring’s mixture.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r12.anchor: أي بسببها على طريقة المزاج منها

BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r13.claim: The muqarrabūn are those drawn near to God; they drink the spring’s blend, while others have no access to the spring itself.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r13.anchor: وأما غيرهم فلا يصل إليها أصلا

BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r14.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r14.speaker: بعضهم
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r14.claim: Some say the near ones drink directly from the spring, while the righteous receive a mixture made from it.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r14.anchor: إن المقربين يشربون من هذه العين صرفا

BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r15.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r15.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r15.claim: The criminals’ punishment is explained through believers’ satisfaction at their enemies’ fate, since the criminals wasted worldly life and thereby lost what truly benefits them.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p363/r15.anchor: وكان من أجل النعيم الشماتة بالعدو

DURR-FULL:v8p451/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas says Tasnim is the highest drink in Paradise, drunk pure by the near ones and mixed for the people of the right.
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r7.anchor: وأخرج عبد الرزاق وسعيد بن منصور وعبد بن حميد وابن المنذر وابن أبي حاتم والبيهقي عن ابن عباس {تسنيم} أشرف شراب أهل الجنة

DURR-FULL:v8p451/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r8.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r8.claim: Ibn Masud says Tasnim is a spring in Paradise, mixed for the people of the right and drunk pure by the near ones.
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r8.anchor: وأخرج ابن أبي شيبة وابن المبارك وسعيد بن منصور وهناد وعبد بن حميد وابن المنذر وابن أبي حاتم عن ابن مسعود في قوله: {ومزاجه من تسنيم}

DURR-FULL:v8p451/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r10.speaker: حذيفة بن اليمان
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r10.claim: Hudhayfa says Tasnim is a spring in Eden; the near ones drink it pure, while it flows to the people of the right and mixes their drinks.
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r10.anchor: وأخرج ابن المنذر عن حذيفة بن اليمان قال: تسنيم عين في عدن يشرب بها المقربون صرفا

DURR-FULL:v8p451/r11.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r11.speaker: الكلبي
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r11.claim: Al-Kalbi says Tasnim is a spring that pours down upon them and is the drink of the near ones.
DURR-FULL:v8p451/r11.anchor: وأخرج عبد الرزاق وابن المنذر عن الكلبي قال: تسنيم عين تثعب عليهم من فوق

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p207/r15.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p207/r15.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p207/r15.claim: The clarification identifies Tasnim as a spring from which the brought-near drink.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p207/r15.anchor: ولغرابة ذلك احتيج إلى تبيينه بقوله : { عينا يشرب بها المقربون } ، أي حال كون التسنيم عينا يشرب منها المقربون

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p207/r16.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p207/r16.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p207/r16.claim: The brought-near are the righteous; those who drink from this water are themselves brought near.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p207/r16.anchor: و { المقربون } : هم الأبرار ، أي فالشاربون من هذا الماء مقربون .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r1.claim: The bāʾ may indicate cause, with yashrabu carrying the sense “mix”; the drinkers mix the nectar with Tasnim.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r1.anchor: وباء { يشرب بها } إما سببية ، وعدي فعل { يشرب } إلى ضمير العين بتضمين { يشرب } معنى : يمزج

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r2.claim: On this parse, the brought-near mix the nectar with Tasnim, as the preceding verse says its blend comes from Tasnim.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r2.anchor: لقوله : { ومزاجه من تسنيم } أي يمزجون الرحيق بالتسنيم .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r3.claim: Alternatively, the bāʾ indicates accompaniment; an omitted object is the nectar, which they drink while beside and gathered around the spring.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r3.anchor: وإما باء الملابسة وفعل { يشرب } معدى إلى مفعول محذوف وهو الرحيق ، أي يشربون الرحيق ملابسين للعين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r4.speaker: الأصمعي والفارسي وابن قتيبة وابن مالك
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r4.claim: Al-Aṣmaʿī, al-Fārisī, Ibn Qutayba, and Ibn Mālik list a partitive bāʾ meaning “from,” an interpretation attributed to Kufan grammarians.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r4.anchor: وقد عده الأصمعي والفارسي وابن قتيبة وابن مالك في معاني الباء ، وينسب إلى الكوفيين .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r5.claim: Ibn ʿĀshūr finds the partitive reading unclear: Arabic commonly constructs “drink” with bāʾ rather than min, so the grammarians may mean accompaniment.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r5.anchor: وليس ذلك ببين فإن الاستعمال العربي يكثر فيه تعدية فعل الشرب بالباء دون ( من ) ، ولعلهم أرادوا به معنى الملابسة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r6.claim: Another possibility is an extra bāʾ, as in Abū Dhūʾayb’s line about clouds drinking sea water and rising above it.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p208/r6.anchor:
أو كانت الباء زائدة كقول أبي ذؤيب يصف السحاب :
شربن بماء البحر ثم ترفعت

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p453/r16.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p453/r16.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p453/r16.claim: Ibn Abbas and Ibn Masʿud say Tasnim is Paradise’s finest drink, a spring the near ones drink pure.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p453/r16.anchor: فقال ابن عباس وابن مسعود: تسنيم أشرف شراب في الجنة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p453/r17.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p453/r17.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p453/r17.claim: Ibn Masʿud, Ibn Abbas, al-Hasan, Abu Salih, and others say Tasnim is mixed into the righteous’ drink.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p453/r17.anchor: ويمزج رحيق الأبرار بها، قاله ابن مسعود وابن عباس والحسن وأبو صالح وغيرهم،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r3.claim: عينا may be an accusative of praise or governed by تسنيم if it is a verbal noun.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r3.anchor: وعينا منصوب إما على المدح، وإما أن يعمل فيه تسنيم على رأي من رآه مصدرا،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r4.speaker: الأخفش
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r4.claim: Al-Akhfash allows a circumstantial accusative from Tasnim or يسقون; Ibn Atiyya says this is far-fetched.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r4.anchor: أو ينتصب على الحال من تسنيم أو يسقون، قاله الأخفش وفيه بعد،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r5.claim: يشرب بها means يشربها, drinks it; Abu Dhuʾayb’s line supports this.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r5.anchor: وقوله تعالى: يشرب بها معناه: يشربها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r6.speaker: أبو ذؤيب الهذلي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p454/r6.claim: Abu Dhuʾayb uses شربن بماء البحر with a preposition for drinking water.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p353/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p353/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود، ابن عباس، مسروق، قتادة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p353/r3.claim: The close ones drink Tasnīm unmixed, while it is blended for the people of the right; Ibn Masʿūd, Ibn ʿAbbās, Masrūq, Qatada, and others hold this view.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p353/r3.anchor: أي: يشربها المقربون صرفا، وتمزج لأصحاب اليمين مزجا. قاله ابن مسعود، وابن عباس، ومسروق، وقتادة، وغيرهم

JISHUMI:v10p7325#2/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7325#2/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7325#2/r10.claim: The muqarrabūn are those brought near to God’s honor, namely angels, the servants nearest to that honor.
JISHUMI:v10p7325#2/r10.anchor: المقرب: من القرب، يعني قربوا إلى كرامة الله، وهم الملائكة هاهنا؛ لأنهم أقرب العباد إلى كرامته.

MUQATIL:83:18-29/r10.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:83:18-29/r10.speaker: author
MUQATIL:83:18-29/r10.claim: Tasnim flows down from the Garden of Eden, described as Paradise’s core; the close ones of that garden drink wine mixed with its water. Muqatil also names al-Kawthar and al-Salsabīl.
MUQATIL:83:18-29/r10.anchor: عينا } من جنة عدن، فتنصب عليم أنصبابا، فذلك قوله: { يشرب بها المقربون } [آية: 28] يقول: يشربون به الخمر

NASAFI-FULL:v4p325#3/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p325#3/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p325#3/r1.claim: “A spring” is accusative either as a circumstantial expression or as an accusative of praise.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p325#3/r1.anchor: ﴿ عينا ﴾ حال أو نصب على المدح

NASAFI-FULL:v4p325#3/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p325#3/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p325#3/r2.claim: The phrase means that they drink from it.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p325#3/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p325#3/r3.speaker: ابن عباس وابن مسعود
NASAFI-FULL:v4p325#3/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and Ibn Masʿūd say the close ones drink it unmixed, while it is blended for the companions of the right.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p325#3/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس وابن مسعود رضى الله عنهم يشربها المقربون صرفا وتمزج لأصحاب اليمين

QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r1.claim: He connects the spring to the unseen delights of the Garden promised in al-Sajdah.
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r1.anchor: فلا تعلم نفس مآ أخفي لهم من قرة أعين

QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r2.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r2.claim: Qatada says Tasnim is a spring flowing through the air by God's power, poured into the vessels of the people of Paradise in measured amounts; when a vessel is full the flow stops, no drop falls to earth, and they need not draw water.
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r2.anchor: وقيل: التسنيم عين تجري في الهواء بقدرة الله تعالى، فتنصب في أواني أهل الجنة على قدر مائها

QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r3.speaker: ابن زيد
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r3.claim: Ibn Zayd says they were told that Tasnim flows from beneath the Throne; Hasan's mursal reports say the same.
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r3.anchor: ابن زيد: بلغنا أنها عين تجري من تحت العرش. وكذا في مراسيل الحسن

QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r4.claim: The foremost residents of the Garden of Eden drink Tasnim unmixed, while it is blended for the other people of Paradise.
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r4.anchor: أي يشرب منها أهل جنة عدن، وهم أفاضل أهل الجنة، صرفا، وهي لغيرهم مزاج

QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r5.claim: The accusative “ʿaynan” can be a commendatory accusative.

QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r6.speaker: الزجاج
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r6.claim: Al-Zajjaj treats ʿaynan as a circumstantial accusative from Tasnim, which he regards as a definite name without a known derivation; if derived from sanam, it is an object, like the example from al-Balad.
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r6.anchor: وقال الزجاج: نصب على الحال من تسنيم، وتسنيم معرفة، ليس يعرف له اشتقاق

QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r7.speaker: الفراء
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r7.claim: Al-Farra also analyzes the accusative as an object governed by Tasnim.
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r7.anchor: وهذا قول الفراء إنه منصوب بتسنيم

QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r8.speaker: الأخفش
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r8.claim: Al-Akhfash makes ʿaynan depend on yusqawn: they are given to drink a spring, or from a spring.
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r8.anchor: وعند الأخفش ب «يسقون» أي يسقون عينا أو من عين

QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r9.speaker: المبرد
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r9.claim: Al-Mubarrad supplies an omitted aʿni (“I mean”), making the accusative commendatory.
QURTUBI-FULL:83:28/r9.anchor: وعند المبرد بإضمار أعني على المدح
